lastCompletedStory.title: Resolve host uid/gid and thread build-args through the production ensure-up path

nextStoryContext:
US-002 is done. resolveHostIds (ContainerSpawnFn injectable seam) is exported from worker-container.ts: calls id -u / id -g, parseInt with NaN fallback to 1000, empty stdout guard for noUncheckedIndexedAccess. makeProductionEnsureContainerFn now calls resolveHostIds(spawnFn) and passes build: { hostUid, hostGid } into ensureWorkerContainer. Both absent (created) and image-stale (rebuilt) branches in ensureWorkerContainer already forward opts.build to runWorkerContainer, so the --build-arg HOST_UID/HOST_GID reach docker build argv on both branches. docs/recovery-runbook.md now documents the claude-code-config volume upgrade caveat. Budget raised for 4 files (split-'
'.length = wc -l + 1 for trailing-newline files). Check what remaining stories exist in prd.json.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed: id -u and id -g always output numeric uid/gid followed by \n. No -n flag used so no name substitution. Implementation (trim + parseInt + NaN guard) matches POSIX spec exactly.
